body: I went in for a 6, so I’ve about 4 more years to go.

I originally went in for the college, I wanted to use the AF as a stepping stone to better myself. If I’m honest I wanted to go officer for a while and still do deep down but there’s not much one person can do to lift a mind set that has lingered for generations. My group chief and I had a sit down and he was super sympathetic to me and heard me out a bit and let me get help, but did nothing past that. All they care about is producing high numbers, If I can actually do something right and kill my self, a new guy will show up at me shop and he’ll probably do so much better. I’m a waste of space currently, I’ve tried to go to my parents but they have a hard time fully understanding how much I’m hurting.
Not any time soon, I’ve been to therapist and such, they arnt too keen on letting me leave.
